name: bordercut
description: Tiny, dependency-free background removal that runs locally in browsers, Node.js, Dart, and Flutter.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run dev --workspace @bordercut/minimal-web-example
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run build --workspace @bordercut/minimal-web-example && npm run build --workspace @bordercut/node-sharp-example
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @bordercut/minimal-web-example && npm run typecheck --workspace @bordercut/node-sharp-example
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:size && npm run test:examples && npm run test:pack
